Synced with `dioxus-shadcn` **0.7.0** (100 public components across 8 categories).

- **Crate mode**: add the feature under `dioxus-shadcn = { version = "0.7", default-features = false, features = [...] }` and import from `dioxus_shadcn::<module>` (or crate root re-exports).
- **Source-copy mode**: run `dxui add <slug>` and import from `crate::components::ui::<module>`.
- **Live docs & examples**: `https://ui.dioxuspress.dev/components/<slug>`
